title: FELICITA - A proof of concept study: open label phase IIa trial evaluating the effect and safety of transplantation of fecal microbiota in children with autism spectrum disorders and gastrointestinal symptoms
official: FELICITA - A proof of concept study: open label phase IIa trial evaluating the effect and safety of transplantation of fecal microbiota in children with autism spectrum disorders and gastrointestinal symptoms
summary: Main objective: Assess initial efficacy on gastrointestinal symptoms of fecal microbiota transplantation in children (36 to 72 months) with autism spectrum disorders at week 18
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. ASD diagnosis based on DSM-5 criteria
2. Gastrointestinal symptoms: at least 1 a score of 5 on 1 of the 5 GSRS domains (diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, reflux) for over a period of 1 year or more
3. Age between 36 and 72 months
4. Consent from all legal guardians
5. Social insurance affiliation
Exclusion criteria:
1. Severe intellectual deficit (IQ<30) or another uncontrolled comorbidity (e.g. epilepsy)
2. Antibiotic or antifungal therapy 3 months before inclusion
3. Probiotics 2 months before inclusion or FMT 12 months before inclusion
4. Vancomycin or Picoprep® or Meopa® (including excipients) known allergy or intolerance
5. Experimental therapeutic trial participation 3 months before inclusion
6. Recent change in ASD global care (cognitive behavioral therapy 6 weeks before inclusion)
7. Actual or past psychotropic medication
8. Contraindications to colon preparation (Picoprep®) and/or to Meopa®)
9. Severe or uncontrolled gastrointestinal symptoms (e.g. urgent treatment needed)
10. Undernutrition (age related BMI < 3rd percentile)
11. Inflammatory bowel disease
12. Exclusive diet (gluten- or sugar-free)
13. Rectal enema contraindication
